view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal shelving units packed with red plastic crates. An orange forklift is parked on the right near wooden pallets. The floor is concrete, and overhead lighting illuminates the space. A distant doorway at the end of the aisle emits bright light.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered metal shelves line both sides of the aisle, filled with red plastic bins. They extend into the distance, creating perspective. The left shelf is closer to the camera and more detailed. No visible mounting hardware.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Numerous red plastic storage bins are stacked on the shelves. Some have visible labels like 'HYDAC'. They are arranged in rows and vary in size. Many are stacked high, partially obscuring the shelves behind them.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle, near wooden pallets. Its black steering column and seat are visible. It is positioned close to the camera's viewpoint, partially blocking the view of the shelves behind it.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets are stacked on the right side of the aisle, near the forklift. One has a wooden crate on top. They sit directly on the concrete floor, appearing stationary.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor is smooth, gray concrete covering the entire ground area. It reflects some overhead light and shows no visible markings or debris. It extends from the foreground to the back of the aisle.

objects.label: yellow and black striped safety cone
objects.observation: A yellow and black striped safety cone is placed on the floor near the base of the left shelf. It is positioned to mark an area or prevent access. It stands upright on the concrete floor.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: A brightly lit doorway is visible at the far end of the aisle, suggesting an exit or entrance. It is framed by the shelving on either side and appears as a source of strong backlighting.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33088", "image_size": [640, 480], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
